recommended.name: Cuenta hipotética bruta USD ligada a SOFR realizada
recommended.rate_administrator: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
recommended.compounding: at next official business-date boundary; simple within weekends/holidays
recommended.start_boundary: Jan 1 2022 Saturday: prior Dec 31 effective rate applies only for Jan 1-Jan 3, two days; no Dec 31 accrual
recommended.end_boundary: Aug 31 2026 effective rate accrues through Sep 1 00:00 UTC; exclude Sep 1 effective rate
recommended.daily_alignment: map economic date labels to UTC calendar days; carry close end-of-day minus 1ns paired with completed benchmark calendar-day accrual, explicitly a daily convention
recommended.annual_and_H3_cuts: preserve inherited principal, balance and pending simple accrual; never restart 10000 or compound early at a cut
recommended.publication: approximately 08:00 America/New_York next business day; economic date is not publication timestamp
recommended.revision: use final public snapshot acquired for this proposal; retain revisionIndicator; no claim of historical publication vintages
recommended.revision_policy_current_source: same initial publication day, approximately 14:30 ET, subject to administrator policy
recommended.access: no real product or contractual access; synthetic 10000 scale has no commercial minimum
risk_limits: not a guaranteed paid deposit return
smooth accounting is not absence of risk
